description: Header file defining cryptographic function interfaces for the EAD module, including functions to set encryption key, encrypt, and decrypt messages.

methods.name: ead_set_key
methods.description: Sets the encryption key for the cryptographic operations.

methods.name: ead_encrypt_message
methods.description: Encrypts a message struct of specified length.

methods.name: ead_decrypt_message
methods.description: Decrypts a message struct and returns status.
